description: The dataset records 20 aerosol samples collected during two monitoring events (PS106/1-track and PS106/2-track) across five stages. Each record includes the sample identifier, aerosol size range 0.05‑0.14 µm to 3.5‑10 µm, timestamps, and coordinates for two sampling times. Latitude values span 0 to 82.34° and longitude 0 to 33.02°. Chemical analyses provide concentrations of chloride, nitrate, sulfate, oxalate, bromide, methanesulfonic acid, sodium, ammonium, potassium and magnesium, ranging from 0 to 215.7 µg m⁻³ for Cl⁻ and up to 452.6 µg m⁻³ for SO₄²⁻. The columns serve as identifiers, categorical groupings, temporal markers, and atmospheric chemistry measurements. Researchers can use this data to study aerosol composition, size distribution, and spatial‑temporal variability in Arctic environments.
